code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation and pO2) and acidemia (low arterial pH), suggesting significant respiratory compromise. There is mild leukopenia, neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild hypoalbuminemia, with monocytosis and basophilia. Total protein is slightly low. These findings may indicate acute or chronic respiratory failure, possible infection or inflammation, and mild bone marrow suppression. Immediate clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
